errors.quote: A fixed rational linear combination of the controls, reduced modulo $Q$, qualifies.
errors.problem: The page leaves out the hypothesis that the rational coefficients have denominators prime to $q$. Without it, the combination cannot be reduced modulo $Q=q^b$. Lemma lem:ordered-affine-streams (paper lines 557-568) fixes 'finitely many rational coefficients whose denominators are prime to $q$' before saying such a combination, 'specialized modulo $Q$', qualifies. Lines 623-626 then compute these reductions with the extended Euclidean algorithm.
